changes_made.explanation: Normalized dataset names to standard forms (WikiSQL, Spider), merged duplicate 'Synthetic Dataset' entries, and changed 'Other:Text-to-SQL Generation' to standard 'Text-to-SQL Generation' task name

Consolidated all variations of exact match accuracy into single normalized form. Removed 'Execution Accuracy' as the paper explicitly states they don't use it due to issues with gold SQL queries not producing correct answers in some cases.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper uses BERT as part of the parsing models, but not for evaluation/judgment purposes.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper relies solely on automatic evaluation metrics.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on text-to-SQL parsing as an NLG task. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of dataset names and consolidation of metric variants. The paper evaluates SQL query generation using exact match accuracy as the primary metric. No human or LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted.
